Diagram showing gametogenesis side-by-side. Left side: Anther cross-section showing pollen sacs, with a magnified pollen grain showing a tube nucleus and generative nucleus. Right side: An ovule cross-section showing the embryo sac. Inside the embryo sac, label the 3 antipodal cells at the top, the 2 polar nuclei in the centre, and the egg cell flanked by 2 synergids at the bottom near the micropyle.

A three-part sequence diagram tracing development. Panel 1: A fertilized flower showing the ovary and ovule intact, with petals wilting. Panel 2: The ovary expanding, with the ovule inside becoming a seed with a visible tiny embryo and endosperm. Panel 3: A fully formed fruit (like a tomato or pawpaw) cut open to show the thick fleshy pericarp and the mature seeds inside. Labels connecting parts: "Ovary becomes Fruit", "Ovule becomes Seed", "Zygote becomes Embryo".
